Halyk reported 32.6% FY25 and 25.9% Q1-26 — but Stage-3 COVERAGE fell 75.2%->59.2% while Stage 3 rose 6.8%->8.2% and NPL 90+ rose 3.1%->4.7%, so reported ROE is provisioning-deferral-flattered; restoring old coverage costs KZT 176bn (4.7% of equity, ~14% of annual earnings) => NORMALIZED ROE ~22.3%. THE MARKET IS ALREADY PRICING THE NORMALIZED NUMBER at a governance-appropriate COE. The apparent cheapness on headline ROE is not cheapness — we are level with the market, not ahead of it. Price edge -0.7%. The return is CARRY: ~15.0% company-declared dividend + ~5% base price = ~20% gross, less ~4%/yr expected stranding-tail cost = ~16% risk-adjusted vs a 15.0% required return. ~1pp excess. FAIRLY PAID. Ownable as RP_FAIR because fairness is now verified on primary data, the tail is bounded by size (1.08% NLV) and unlevered, and carry-vs-edge is labelled.

honesty_finding_20260805.divergence: Management Q1 language: the quarter "supports the full-year 2026 guidance communicated earlier" — said over a print in which earnings fell 14.6% YoY, NIM compressed 7.5->7.0%, cost/income rose 16.5->18.2%, cost of risk rose 1.2->1.5%, the loan book SHRANK 2.2% QoQ, NPLs rose 160bps and coverage fell 16pp. Every datum IS disclosed (to the company credit) — but the marketed conclusion is not what the data says. This is takeaway-vs-data divergence, NOT a disclosed-bad-news case.
honesty_finding_20260805.quantification: Restoring 75.2% coverage on KZT 1,101bn Stage 3 = KZT 176bn extra provisions = 4.7% of equity. Built over one year: ~KZT 132bn post-tax vs annualised NI ~KZT 939bn = 14.1% earnings hit => Q1 ROE 25.9% normalizes to ~22.3%.
honesty_finding_20260805.earnings_not_solvency: k1-1 21.0% vs a 9.5% minimum (NBK unconsolidated Bank-only basis — do NOT call it CET1). The capital to absorb it exists many times over; the dividend is not threatened by this.
honesty_finding_20260805.company_attribution: Stage-3 build attributed to a moratorium on selling problem retail loans to collection agencies, stated to run "till May 2026" — i.e. it ENDED INSIDE Q2. H1-2026 is the first period that can reveal whether the build unwinds or was masking genuine deterioration.
honesty_finding_20260805.but_is_it_alpha: NO — and that is the honest answer. §3 shows the market at 1.153x is ALREADY pricing the coverage-normalized ~22% ROE, not the reported 25.9-32.6%. We are LEVEL with the market, not ahead of it. The value of the finding is (a) it corrects our own stale panel input, (b) it names the exact tripwire to read on 18-Aug.

governance_finding_20260805.headline: The 15% yield is a controlling-shareholder preference, not a minority right.
governance_finding_20260805.evidence: AGM circular states total VOTING shares 7,904,221,264 vs 10,894,886,733 in circulation — ~3bn shares, almost exactly the GDR block, sit OUTSIDE the voting base. Almex 6,756,738,228 (62.0% of shares) is therefore ~85% of votes actually counted. GDR holders 35.1% of shares, ~0% of effective votes.
governance_finding_20260805.payout_record: FY23 55% (KZT 35.00), FY24 60% (KZT 50.64), FY25 60% (KZT 58.19) — three years unbroken, two ordinary tranches each year.
governance_finding_20260805.overhang: Almex is a proven SELLER — fully marketed GDR secondary of 7.6% (~$475mn) Nov-2025, taking it from ~69.6% to 62.0%. A further block is a live supply overhang against a ~$9bn cap.
governance_finding_20260805.priced_as: ~100bps added to the cost of equity (14.0% -> 15.0%).
